title: Custom three-point bend fixture
description: A 3D printable 12 part three-point bend fixture, designed in SolidWorks 2025 for specimens too delicate for commercial fixtures, with rebuilds automated in VBA.
og_alt: Blurred render of the three-point bend fixture.
lede: Commercial bend fixtures will damage a fragile specimen before the test begins. I designed a fully printable 12 part one for SunThru's samples.

brief.label: Status
brief.value: Base plate and gauge plate printed and in lab use

brief_note: Renders are blurred because the fixture is SunThru hardware.

sections.label: Parametric part design
paras: All 12 parts sit on one shared coordinate system. I automated the rebuilds with SolidWorks VBA, so a dimension change regenerates the affected parts.

sections.label: Designed for printing
paras: Horizontal M3 cross-holes are drawn as printable channels, so nothing needs support material or post-drilling. One hardware size across the whole fixture.
